an10.63:1.1: Ye keci bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṅgatā, sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā.
an10.63:1.2: Tesaṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā, pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā.
an10.63:1.4: Sattakkhattuparamassa, kolaṃkolassa, ekabījissa, sakadāgāmissa, yo ca diṭṭh' eva dhamme arahā:
an10.63:1.7: Antarāparinibbāyissa, upahaccaparinibbāyissa, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa, uddhaṃsotassa akaniṭṭhagāmino:
an10.63:1.9: Ye keci bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṅgatā, sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā.
an10.63:1.10: Tesaṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā
